text.en:
The seat of government of the Province of Maguindanao is hereby returned from the
Municipality of Sultan Kudarat to the Municipality of Maganoy.

The transfer of the seat of government of the Province of Maguindanao shall take effect upon
approval by a majority of the votes cast in a plebiscite to be held in the entire Province of Maguindanao not
later than December 31, 1982.

The Commission on Elections shall conduct and supervise the holding of the plebiscite. The
Provincial Government of Maguindanao is hereby authorized to appropriate the necessary funds to defray the
expenses for such plebiscite.
Presidential Decree Numbered Eleven hundred and seventy is hereby repealed.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 25, 1982
